```card-forge
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: generic
data:
  # The front's title.
  title: House Rule

  # The front's italic subtitle.
  subtitle: Optional rule

  # The front's text (markdown) — in the block, or as a `## Front` section of the note.
  content: Describe the rule here …

  # The front's footer, under the red line.
  footer: Rules p. 12

  # The top-left icon — a path under the system, e.g. `assets/icons/skills.svg`.
  icon-left: assets/icons/skills.svg

  # Small caps above the left icon — a card type, say.
  label-left: Ability

  # The top-right icon — a path under the system, e.g. `assets/icons/hood.svg`.
  icon-right: # no sample

  # Small caps above the right icon — a sub-type, say.
  label-right: # no sample

  # The back's title. With a title, subtitle, text or footer the back becomes a second text face instead of the wordmark back.
  back-heading: # no sample

  # The back's italic subtitle.
  back-subtitle: # no sample

  # The back's text (markdown) — in the block, or as a `## Back` section of the note.
  back-content: # no sample

  # The back's footer, under the red line.
  back-colophon: # no sample

  # The icon above the back's wordmark — a path under the system.
  icon-upper: # no sample

  # Small caps under the back's top icon.
  label-upper: # no sample

  # The icon below the back's wordmark — a path under the system.
  icon-lower: # no sample

  # Small caps under the back's bottom icon.
  label-lower: # no sample
```
